name: leaf-gbc2-model-lunar-leaf-5day-simulation
title: LEAF GBC2 'Model Lunar LEAF' 5-Day Spaceflight Simulation Dataset
description: Comprehensive 5-day (120-hour) computational multi-physics dataset for the LEAF GBC2 spaceflight plant growth chamber. Encompasses subsurface water activation in porous foam, Nytex mesh root exclusion, push vs pull aerodynamic CFD, developmental ontogeny, mixed-convection gravity (0g-1g), temperature sweeps (18-30 C), and optical lid condensation defense.

resources.name: 5day_hourly_telemetry
resources.description: Hourly 120-hour multi-species state matrix covering canopy height, leaf area, drag factor, CO2 exchange, transpiration, and condensation margin.

resources.name: push_vs_pull_aerodynamics
resources.description: Comparative aerodynamic metrics across 10 pump speeds for Push (positive gauge) vs Pull (suction negative gauge) flow regimes.

resources.name: gravity_temp_response_surface
resources.description: Full factorial response surface spanning 4 gravity levels (0g, 0.166g, 0.38g, 1.0g), 5 air temperatures (18-30 C), and 5 ventilation rates.

resources.name: water_activation_foam_nytex
resources.description: Vertical moisture saturation profiles in the 7.0 mm porous foam cassette and Nytex mesh Young-Laplace bubble point curve.
